summary: The filing reports an 8-K under Items 1.01 and 5.02, disclosing that G-III Apparel Group's Compensation Committee awarded performance share units (PSUs) to named executive officers under the 2023 Long-Term Incentive Plan. The PSUs vest based on three-year cumulative Adjusted EBIT (75% weighting) and three-year average ROIC (25% weighting) over fiscal 2027–2029. No price, premium, or transaction terms apply as this is a routine executive compensation grant, not a special situation. The filing is purely administrative and does not involve a M&A event, capital return, or structural change.
